name: ScanBox local vision pack (Florence-2-base for macOS)
notes: FP16 ONNX weights, approximately 780 MB total. INT8 was tried first
to match Windows exactly, but ONNX Runtime's Apple Silicon CPU
provider has no kernel for the ConvInteger op INT8-quantized conv
layers use, so it fails to load entirely. FP16 uses ordinary
float math instead of integer quantization, so it loads correctly
and stays much closer to full quality than INT8 or Q4F16.
decoding - the same graph architecture Windows uses for its INT8
pack. decoder_with_past_model_fp16.onnx was tried first since it
looked like a safer bet, but it turned out to be statically exported
for a fixed 16-token window and rejects normal one-token generation
at run time. The merged graph (which switches between first-pass and
cached decoding via a use_cache_branch flag) is dynamically shaped
